evidence_levels.code_observation: Pinned file bodies/regions, test definitions, callback dispatch predicates, read/publish/cleanup ownership
evidence_levels.deduction: A test using get alone cannot select the begin/end overlap branch; equal outputs from shared placement logic do not independently establish correct bytes
evidence_levels.author_reports: Historical common-corruption bug, gate repair, actual checkpoint layout and numerical/performance results remain attributed upstream reports

claim_boundaries: Buffered pread byte oracle shares the safetensors metadata/index; its independence is from aligned/coalesced placement, not from parsing.
Gate 6 byte-compares six tensors for fixture experts it obtains; do not describe its skip-on-missing behavior as exhaustive coverage.
Gate 8 snapshots resident w1 weights only; no all-tensor/all-eviction/all-timing proof follows.
Missing/invalid tensor metadata is rejected before victim selection; a partial I/O failure invalidates the chosen slot and is fatal to the model consumer.

Only one batch per cache is contracted. Returned residents and claimed pending slots have different lifetimes; end waits and publishes successful misses, and shutdown joins readers before freeing storage.
Expert computation uses shared scratch sequentially; reads overlap it. Per-k outputs do not alias the MoE input and are summed in k order.
Model gate wires begin/end, checks tolerant PyTorch logits plus argmax, then checks batched C logits bitwise against its validated per-token C path.
Tiny checkpoint/reference omit production-scale quality, full model domain, activation quantization and Hadamard behavior. Missing resources print SKIP and return 0.
